title: Sonatina in C major, Op. 36 No. 1 (1st movement)
subtitle: Spiritoso
trains: A brisk single-line melody in the right hand (scale runs, octave leaps, broken octaves) over a light left hand of mostly quarter, half and whole notes, with broken-chord eighths in bars 9, 11, 32 and 34: an exposition that moves to G major, a short development that turns to C minor (bars 16-23), and the return in C - reading fluency and a fast, even tempo more than technical difficulty.

provenance.credit: Typeset by Brian D. Rude for the Mutopia Project (Mutopia-2016/11/30-804) from the Sonatina Album (G. Schirmer, 1893), and placed in the public domain by the typesetter.
provenance.note: The first movement of the source file (which holds all three), converted from Mutopia's LilyPond source to MusicXML; beams and accidentals then completed by pnpm library:engrave. Complete, with both written repeats: 38 bars. The playback tempo, half note = 78 (quarter = 156), is the source MIDI's; the notation prints no metronome mark. pnpm library:fidelity re-checks the notes against the source and its MIDI (0 differences).
